record.question: The scale on which three dimension can be measured is known as —
record.explanation: In the conventional scale terminology, a diagonal scale reads three successive units such as metres,decimetres and centimetres. “Three dimension” in the source means these three subdivisions, not three spatial axes. Reference: https://bharatskills.gov.in/pdf/E_Books/Surveyor1stsemTT.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
